rationale: P11 is the only card where the killer feature (Phoenix MCP + LLM-as-judge spec-fit climb 0.71->0.96) IS the hero pixel rather than chrome around it. Stack is boring-by-design (Next.js pages router + Postgres + SSE + Cloud Run) which maximizes 36-day deliverability for a 2-person team and minimizes blast radius. Per-flow score table with judge notes plus live trace tail directly map to OpenInference spans, making Arize-track bonus criterion testable in code on Day 1, not Day 30. Hardcoded URL fixture for the 4-day cut is honest scope discipline; deploy/submission can be wired post-MVP without touching the loop demo. P02 (Ops NOC) and P13 (Data Nerd) are the strongest runners-up because they also surface Phoenix traces as primary content - both score high on Tech Implementation axis, but P02 risks under-delivering on the wow factor (alerts are not vindicating) and P13 risks chart-porn over agent-substance. P24 earns its slot for honesty engineering: public failure log + trace links per objection is genuinely novel and de-risks the demo against skeptical judges. P26 is the dark horse: anti-AI minimalism with a deterministic 6-stage status pill is the most shippable surface and the satire lands harder when the artifact looks real. Cuts: P05/P18 (design-only, loop is faked via frozen iframes), P10/P15/P17/P21 (scope explodes past 36 days), P12 (self-hosted Phoenix breaks the locked stack assumption), P22 (synthetic stats with kappa/sigma create integrity risk), P14/P23 (double-build burden for 2 people).
dissent_items: Phoenix MCP free tier caps at 50k traces/mo; need quota guardrail and trace sampling policy before any live demo
Self-improvement loop must have a hard convergence ceiling (e.g. max 7 iterations or $X budget) to avoid runaway Cloud Run spend
LLM-as-judge prompt is the eval rubric - it MUST be versioned in repo and shown verbatim in UI for Arize-track credibility
Spec-fit score formula needs to be deterministic and auditable; otherwise judges will flag it as vibes-not-evidence
Hardcoded fixture for 4-day demo (P11 admits this) means full URL->deploy path needs a stretch-day before submission
Cloud Run cold-start on first deploy can blow the visible 10-min SLA; need pre-warmed image or buildpack cache strategy
OpenInference auto-instrumentation must cover ADK + Agent Builder + Gemini calls; gaps will silently break the loop
Trace correlation across iteration N->N+1 needs a stable run_id; Postgres schema should pin this on Day 1
Killer-feature visibility: convergence chart MUST animate live during demo, not replay - judges discount canned playback
OSI license + public repo gate is Stage-1 disqualifier if missed; LICENSE file commit must happen Week 1 not Week 5
2-person team cannot also build SDK/Slack/CLI surfaces simultaneously; dissent against any winner that adds non-web surfaces
Failure-log transparency (P24 idea) should be adopted regardless of winner - hides nothing, defuses skepticism
Background loop continuing after first Cloud Run URL needs idempotent deploy strategy or revisions will pile up
Phoenix MCP queries from the agent itself (not a sidecar) is the integration depth judges check - verify wiring early
